summary.en: Insert and remove at either endpoint using a circular array or a doubly linked chain.
summary.bn: Circular অ্যারে বা doubly linked node দিয়ে দুই প্রান্তে মান যোগ ও সরাও।

notes: Programs use C17 with explicit bounds and ownership checks.

examples.title: Exercise all four ring operations
examples.explanationHtml: Front insertion puts twenty before ten; rear removal takes thirty, then front removal takes twenty.

examples.title: Alternate linked endpoint insertion
examples.explanationHtml: Front and rear insertions produce [5,3,1,2,4]. Draining from rear prints 4,2,1,3,5.

examples.title: Refuse both empty endpoint removals
examples.explanationHtml: Both empty operations are refused; inserting and removing seven restores count zero.

practice.title: Implement the four-ended command stream
practice.statementHtml: Read 0..16 operation/value pairs. Operation 1 inserts front, 2 inserts rear, 3 removes front, 4 removes rear; removal ignores its value. Use capacity four. Print the prompt, Removed:/Full/Empty messages and final Items: in front-to-rear order.
hints: Rear is derived from front and count; do not mix next-write and last-live indices.

practice.title: Alternate endpoint insertion in linked nodes
practice.statementHtml: Read n (0..16) and values -99..99. Insert even-indexed values at front and odd-indexed values at rear. Print the prompt then Removed from rear: and the drain order; free every node.
hints: Repair both directions whenever a node enters or leaves.

practice.title: Enforce an input restriction
practice.statementHtml: Use the deque operation/value command format and prompt. Refuse operation 1 with Restricted; perform the other operations normally. Keep action messages and final Items: format. This makes the deque input restricted.
hints: Reject the forbidden request before mutating count or endpoints.

practice.title: Enforce an output restriction
practice.statementHtml: Use the deque operation/value command format and prompt. Refuse operation 4 with Restricted; perform the other operations normally. Keep action messages and final Items: format. This makes the deque output restricted.
hints: Reject the forbidden request before mutating count or endpoints.

quiz.prompt: Which operation distinguishes a deque from an ordinary FIFO queue?
quiz.explanation: A FIFO interface removes only the oldest front entry.

options: Insert at both, remove at one
Insert at one end, remove at both
Remove at both, insert at one
Remove at one end, insert at both
quiz.explanation: Output refers to removal from the structure.

quiz.prompt: Which ring formula steps front backward safely?
quiz.explanation: The nonnegative numerator avoids a negative remainder.

quiz.prompt: What must linked deletion of the only node do?
quiz.explanation: There is no remaining front or rear.

quiz.prompt: What time does a doubly linked endpoint deletion require?
quiz.explanation: Both neighbor directions are already available.

quiz.prompt: After rear-in 1, front-in 2, rear-in 3, what is front-to-rear?
quiz.explanation: The second insertion goes before one; the third follows it.

quiz.prompt: Which index receives a front insertion when front is zero in capacity four?
quiz.explanation: The predecessor of zero wraps to three.

quiz.prompt: Where is the last live deque cell for front=3 and count=2?
quiz.explanation: The two cells are three then zero.

quiz.prompt: What count remains after two inserts and one endpoint removal?
quiz.explanation: Each successful endpoint removal reduces size once.

quiz.prompt: Which singly linked deque operation still needs a predecessor search despite a saved tail?
quiz.explanation: The tail does not directly identify its predecessor without backward links.

keyPoints.en: A deque permits insertion and removal at both ends.
keyPoints.bn: Deque-তে দুই দিকেই মান রাখা ও সরানো যায়।

keyPoints.en: A ring deque can derive rear from front and count.
keyPoints.bn: Ring deque-তে front ও count থেকে rear বের করা যায়।

keyPoints.en: Add capacity before stepping an index backward.
keyPoints.bn: Index পেছালে বিয়োগের আগে capacity যোগ করো।

keyPoints.en: A doubly linked deque repairs both neighbor directions.
keyPoints.bn: Doubly linked deque-তে পাশের দুই দিকের link ঠিক করো।

keyPoints.en: Restricted deques limit the public operations, not the stored order.
keyPoints.bn: Restricted deque-তে কাজের অনুমতি কমে, মানের ক্রম বদলায় না।

examQuestions.question: Trace rear-in 4, front-in 2, rear-in 8, rear-out, front-out.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Front-to-rear states are [4], [2,4], [2,4,8], [2,4], [4]. The removals return eight and two, respectively.

examQuestions.question: A service accepts arrivals only at the rear but allows cancellation at either end. Name the restriction and explain which operation is disabled.
examQuestions.answerHtml: This is an input-restricted deque. Insertion is allowed at one end, here the rear. Removal remains available at both front and rear. Front insertion is disabled by the public interface, even if an internal implementation could support it.

examQuestions.question: For capacity five and front zero, calculate the index for front insertion. Explain why (front-1)%5 is unsafe as an index in C.
examQuestions.answerHtml: (front+5-1)%5 gives four. C remainder can be negative when its left operand is negative, so (0-1)%5 gives -1. Adding capacity before subtraction keeps this bounded calculation nonnegative.
